title: Say Biahe na Inampon a Kamarerwa
intro: Diad panaon ya saray estandarte na sosyedad so manuley, sakey a nikadkaduman indibidual so akaeksperiensya na baleg a pananguman ed loob na sakey a mapalar a sankaabungan. Say istorya ra, ya atandaan na bedber na panangaro tan madibinon ganggan, so mangiyiilustra ed inkagba na saray daan a tradisyon tan say inkiletneg na balo, matunong iran prinsipyo. Ipapabitar na sayan salaysay so kaimportantian na katuaan nen say kombension tan say kakabatan ed benegan na saray ganggan nen Allah.
clues: Akautibo ak nensaman, balet diad panamegley na madibinon uksoyan et akaromog ak na balon ayaman tan pamilya.
Inad-aro ak kanian nen naitdan ak na pilian ed baetan na pamilyak tan say inampon kon guardian, pinilik so mansiansia ed unor.
Say ngaran ko et datin nisiglaot ed inampon kon guardian, sakey a kagagawa ed sosyedad mi.
Siak labat so kaiba na unor a Propeta ya say ngaran to et malinew ya abitla nen Allah ed Quran.
Akaasawa ak na sakey a gagalangen a bii ya kapinsan na Propeta, balet ag abayag so panamaley mi.
Kayari na diborsyo ko, si Allah a mismo so angiganggan ya say datin asawak so mangasawa ed Propeta, diad ontan et naandi so kadaanan a kustombre nipaakar ed panag-ampon.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
